title: Trump Headlines Texas Convention
description:
On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Kailey Leinz is live in Dallas. On today's show, Republican Congressman Jim Jordan of Ohio, former Texas Congressman Beto O'Rourke, former US Ambassador to Japan Rahm Emanuel and Republican Congressman Beth Van Duyne of Texas.
